sources.name: Norges Kirker – Aremark kirke
findings: A medieval stone church dedicated to St. Lawrence stood at the kirkested.
The medieval church was demolished in 1860.
The current brick church was designed by Peter Høier Holtermann and built in 1860–1861.
The current church was consecrated on 6 November 1861.
Older inventory was transferred into the new church.
